name: Chronograph Lp
description: Portfolio monitoring and analytics for private-capital LP teams using the Chronograph connector: cashflow forecasting, commitment pacing, look-through exposure scans and GP-meeting prep. Requires a Chronograph account and the Chronograph connector.
longDescription:
Ships **4 skills** and **5 agents**.

- **Skills** (4): `chronograph-cashflow-forecast` (Forecast LP-level private capital cashflows for existing portfolios using Chronograph MCP data and a Takahashi-Alexander style model), `chronograph-commitment-pacing-planner` (Plan forward fund commitments to reach and hold a target private capital allocation, using Chronograph portfolio data and…), `chronograph-gp-meeting-prep` (Prepare an LP (investor) to meet with their fund manager (GP) — an LP-side skill where the user…), `chronograph-look-through-exposure-scan` (Aggregate an LP's look-through portfolio exposure across funds — by company, sector, geography, vintage, strategy, and currency —…)
- **Agents** (5): `chronograph-cashflow-forecast` (Private capital cashflow forecasting agent for LP-level portfolio analysis using the Chronograph MCP and a Takahashi-Alexander style model), `chronograph-commitment-pacing-planner` (Commitment pacing agent — plans forward fund commitments to reach and hold a target private capital allocation using…), `chronograph-gp-meeting-prep` (LP-side meeting preparation agent (preparing an LP to meet their GP) — reviews fund reporting, surfaces period-over-period changes,…), `chronograph-look-through-exposure-scan` (Look-through exposure agent — aggregates underlying exposure across funds and surfaces concentration using the Chronograph top-exposures tool), `chronograph-lp-analyst` (End-to-end LP portfolio analysis orchestrator — cashflow forecasting, commitment pacing, look-through exposure scans, and GP-meeting prep, all from…)

Installs with `claude plugin install chronograph-lp@claude-plugins-official` from `chronograph-pe/chronograph-lp-claude-plugin`.
